summary: Student-first machine candidate for Cambridge education, assessment, information-compliance, and AI Policy Framework records. Local tripos, department, faculty, and college rules control; the framework is not one university-wide allowance.

dimensions.summary: Cambridge broadly permits appropriate GenAI for personal study, research, and formative work, while local units determine allowance. Scope: education guidance plus local-policy framework.

do: Check the local tripos, department, faculty, or college rule.
dont: Do not treat “broadly permits” as permission for every assessment.

dimensions.summary: Unacknowledged AI-generated content in a summative assessment is academic misconduct unless the assessment brief explicitly says otherwise. Scope: Cambridge assessment guidance.

do: Read the assessment brief for permitted use and acknowledgement.
dont: Do not submit unacknowledged AI-generated content as your own.

dimensions.summary: Cambridge assessment guidance makes acknowledgement material to whether AI-generated content is treated as misconduct. Scope: summative assessment guidance.

do: Acknowledge AI-generated content when the assessment rule requires it.
dont: Do not hide AI-generated content inside a summative submission.

dimensions.summary: Cambridge warns against confidential, sensitive, or personal data in GenAI and distinguishes licensed tools from free or unlicensed tools. Scope: information-compliance guidance.

do: Use the licensed or otherwise authorised path for protected data.
dont: Do not put confidential or personal data into a free or unlicensed tool.

dimensions.summary: Cambridge identifies licensed Copilot, Gemini, and NotebookLM as standard tools; public free versions must not be used for University activities. Provision is not assessment permission.

do: Check the licensed version and the local academic rule.
dont: Do not infer course permission from a licensed-tool list.

dimensions.summary: No source-backed Cambridge research-publication rule is included in this candidate; this is not evidence of permission or prohibition.

primary.notes: Primary author review recorded for this machine candidate; the snapshot is not a student conclusion.

secondary.notes: Independent review returned candidate metadata/copy issues; snapshot remains fail-closed.

limitations: This tracker is not legal advice, not academic integrity advice, and not an official university statement unless a linked source is the university's own official page.
